g.text: GALINI / L03 / SEC10 / Civic crossing and Inn receiving street
Named encounter section / adjacent architecture, explicit positions and a bounded review question
The bent civic span reaches a short high Inn arch,
retaining direct support on parts of its length. On the
west, an occupied receiving shoulder enters A around West
Homes. W02 preserves one cross-level observation; the rest
of the south edge is opaque.
A cross-span follower loses the target when the leader
rounds West Homes. Watching W02 means standing on the span
and facing away from its ends. A learned bridge hold can
be avoided by paying for middle or shore territory, not by

positions. Roofs and slabs remain opaque. Movement openings and observation apertures are different contracts.
